name: Proposal Calculator Modules (PWA, AI, Reports)
description: Calculator modal displays modules in order: PWA (40%), AI (invite-only), Smart Conversions (invite-only), Electronic Invoicing (60%), International Payments (20%), Regional Payments (20%), Email Marketing (10%), Reports & Alerts (20%, default selected), Multi-idioma (15%). Info badge at top of modal. Selecting modules adds ~1 week to timeline.
